name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: This errand directs investigators from Jorgen in the Valley of Heroes to Elling Trias, the proprietor of Trias' Cheese in Stormwind's Trade District. Carrying a discreet sealed note, it bridges palace concerns about the missing diplomat into the quiet contacts kept behind the counter of a modest cheese shop.

sections.title: A Discreet Delivery
sections.body: Following initial inquiries into the disappearance of an unnamed diplomat, Jorgen directs trusted operatives to keep their mouths firmly shut and carry a sealed note across the city. The destination is not an official barracks or a magistrate's office, but Trias' Cheese, nestled in the busy Trade District. The secretive nature of the handover hints at how delicate the matter has become, bypassing ordinary guard channels in favor of informal intelligence.

sections.title: Behind the Shopfront
sections.body: To the casual shopper browsing wheels of Darnassian bleu or sharp cheddar, Master Cheesemonger Elling Trias appears to be nothing more than a jovial, hardworking merchant. In reality, Trias shares some history with Jorgen and keeps contacts of his own well beyond the shop. Delivering Jorgen's note places the search for the missing diplomat quietly into his hands.

faq.answer: On the surface, Elling Trias is a respected merchant running Trias' Cheese in the Trade District of Stormwind. Beneath his culinary trade, he shares some history with Jorgen and has contacts of his own that he can put to use in delicate matters.

faq.q: Why does Jorgen tell me to keep quiet?
faq.answer: The disappearance of the diplomat is a state secret that could incite panic or alert whoever orchestrated the abduction. Jorgen insists on utter discretion so as not to betray that an active investigation is underway.

faq.q: Where can I find Trias' Cheese?
faq.answer: The shop is located in the Trade District of Stormwind City, tucked along the main avenues among the general merchants and craftsmen.

faq.q: What is in the sealed note to Elling?
faq.answer: The letter contains Jorgen's discreet briefing regarding the missing diplomat, calling upon Trias to utilize his specialized contacts and underground ears to locate tracks that conventional authorities cannot trace.

faq.q: Who is the missing diplomat mentioned in the quest?
faq.answer: The royal court keeps the exact identity guarded at this stage of the investigation, though the extreme secrecy and high-level concern point toward someone of immense political significance to the Kingdom of Stormwind.

faq.q: Why would the investigation use a cheesemonger instead of the city guard?
faq.answer: The official city guard is bound by protocol, jurisdiction, and potential political entanglements. Elling Trias has access to street-level whispers and quiet contacts that formal soldiers simply cannot reach.

angles.text: Rogues may suspect that Trias' Cheese is more than a dairy storefront; its owner keeps quiet contacts well beyond the Trade District.
The quiet pursuit of the missing envoy reveals subtle vulnerabilities in Stormwind's leadership during a period when King Varian Wrynn remains absent.
